messages.subject: Kingsgate House – instruction to act
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up on Friday. As discussed, the board has approved proceeding with the Farringdon Road building (Kingsgate House) at £18.5m and we'd like Whitfield Carter to act for Thornbury on the acquisition. The agent has the heads of terms more or less agreed with Belvedere's side.

Could you send your engagement letter and your AML requirements so we can get moving? Keen to exchange before the end of April if possible.

Best,
Daniel

Daniel Quigley
Managing Director
Thornbury Properties Limited

messages.subject: RE: Kingsgate House – instruction to act
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Daniel,

Delighted to act for Thornbury again. Our engagement letter for the acquisition of Kingsgate House is attached, together with a note of our fee estimate (£42,000 plus VAT and disbursements) and the SDLT figure of £914,500. Please sign and return the copy letter at your convenience.

James Osei (Senior Associate) and Elena Marchetti (Associate) will handle the day-to-day work with me. Our reference is WC-00108. I will send the AML/source-of-funds checklist under separate cover shortly.

The end-of-April exchange target is achievable provided we receive the draft contract and title pack promptly from Belvedere's solicitors.
